d:
In this video, I explore Wangxian Valley in Shangrao, China, a breathtaking fairytale-like village built along the mountains and cliffs.
From stunning waterfalls, ancient-style streets and dramatic mountain views to the incredible illuminated village at night, Wangxian Valley feels like stepping into a Chinese fantasy world.
I also explore the story behind this place, its unique architecture, local culture, food and the beautiful landscapes surrounding it.
Join me as I discover one of the most fascinating destinations in China!
